item.title: Taking Notes
item.description:
UPDATE from 2026: I moved to Trilium for note-taking, see the details in this post.

In the days of yore it was common for people to keep a diary. I myself was always a fan of this idea, but could never actually get started with it.

My handwriting is absolutely terrible, to the point that I can’t decipher my own notes, which rules out writing diary in an old-fashioned way. And all diary-like mobile apps seem to add too much friction.
